tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It states one paragraph: TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.

This comes from two recorded decisions. The first (#22) says verification is on for all builds and replaced an older dev-disable decision. The second (#25) says "https everywhere, no exceptions". I left out the retired dev-disable option.

An earlier note about plain http for internal hosts is only an episode, and #25 covers the same ground, so I didn't use it.

The memory system also reported a heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That doesn't affect this file, but the hooks may be timing out.
